scenario: A stable student identifier links portal activity academic records and audit events across purposes
dfd_elements: E1 P1 P2 D1 F1 F2 F7
data_subject_harm: Detailed behavioral or academic profiling beyond the original purpose
privacy_requirement: Use purpose-scoped identifiers and restrict cross-context joins

scenario: Production records and cloud backups remain linkable through direct identifiers and stable row keys
data_subject_harm: A compromise or secondary use can reconstruct a complete longitudinal record
privacy_requirement: Pseudonymize backup indexes and separate key material from backup data

scenario: Combined identity contact enrollment and grade data re-identify a student from the central database
data_subject_harm: Exposure of a complete identifiable academic profile
privacy_requirement: Minimize attributes and enforce field and role level access

scenario: Statistics for a small cohort permit inference about an individual student
data_subject_harm: Indirect identification and disclosure of academic status
privacy_requirement: Apply aggregation thresholds suppression and disclosure review

scenario: Bluetooth transfer exposes named identity documents and transcripts on an unmanaged device
data_subject_harm: Third parties can identify the student and access academic information
privacy_requirement: Replace or constrain Bluetooth transfer and protect exported files

scenario: A complete cloud backup exposes recognizable student records if provider access or configuration fails
data_subject_harm: Large-scale identification of students and disclosure of academic records
privacy_requirement: Encrypt backups with university controlled keys and restrict provider access

scenario: Long-lived audit logs provide durable proof of student actions beyond security need
data_subject_harm: Students lose plausible deniability for sensitive actions or requests
privacy_requirement: Limit event content access and retention to documented security purposes

scenario: SMS delivery metadata can bind a phone number timestamp and verification event to a student
data_subject_harm: A third party can prove participation or account activity
privacy_requirement: Minimize provider metadata and shorten retention

scenario: Traffic timing and message patterns reveal that a student used a sensitive service even when content is encrypted
data_subject_harm: Observers infer enrollment activity account recovery or exceptional requests
privacy_requirement: Reduce observable metadata and avoid revealing message content

scenario: Backup size and timing reveal operational cycles and high-activity academic periods
data_subject_harm: An external party infers institutional or cohort activity
privacy_requirement: Use protected channels fixed schedules where practical and provider monitoring

scenario: Academic identity and transcript files leak during or after Bluetooth transfer
data_subject_harm: Unauthorized access to identity and performance information
privacy_requirement: Provide a managed encrypted export channel with expiry

scenario: A cloud backup incident exposes complete student records
data_subject_harm: Broad and lasting disclosure of academic and contact information
privacy_requirement: Encrypt isolate monitor and regularly test backup access controls

scenario: Students do not receive clear notice that their records are copied to a cloud service
data_subject_harm: Loss of control and inability to understand recipients retention or safeguards
privacy_requirement: Provide layered notice with cloud purpose recipient and retention details

scenario: Students do not understand what the SMS provider receives or retains
data_subject_harm: Students cannot make informed choices or exercise rights effectively
privacy_requirement: Show a just-in-time notice before verification and link to details

scenario: Instructors do not understand the limits on their access to student data
data_subject_harm: Over-broad or secondary use of student information
privacy_requirement: Use role-specific training purpose prompts and access attestations

scenario: Students are not informed when registry staff process requests on their behalf
data_subject_harm: Hidden delegated processing reduces transparency and trust
privacy_requirement: Display delegated-action notices and accessible activity history

scenario: Retention and access rules are not demonstrably mapped to each data class and purpose
data_subject_harm: Data persists or remains accessible beyond necessity
privacy_requirement: Approve and enforce a data and backup retention schedule

scenario: Cloud and SMS processing lacks complete evidence for contracts transfers subprocessors and deletion
data_subject_harm: Students lack enforceable safeguards and the institution cannot demonstrate accountability
privacy_requirement: Maintain processor due diligence contractual controls and transfer evidence
